integrity: All theorem claims have explicit arguments; the finite standalone verifier independently checks small orders but is not an infinite proof. Prior publications and possible equivalent terminology are cited. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies all labelled minimum 1-limited dominating sets for GP(n,2), n>=5; does not classify GP(n,k) for k>2, automorphism orbits, or nonminimum sets. Earlier quotient-matrix existence and general cubic lower bound are not new. Historical priority remains subject to independent assessment.
title: Five-periodic rigidity of minimum 1-limited domination on generalized Petersen graphs
